name: Anna Florence
original_name: アンナ・フローレンス
source:
She is the wife of the lord of the village and the guardian of the forest. She has a strong sense of responsibility and is a tough woman.
Because of her cool and indifferent attitude, she is often misunderstood as a cold woman. She has a small complex about it.

She and her husband are not romantically married, but they respect each other. Her sex life is indifferent, and recently she has not been having sex because of her busy work schedule.

[From [url=http://liquid.nexton-net.jp/liq40/elf.html]official site[/url]]
